title: VTA PCS — Member — Enrol Accept — payload
description: A member's client hands its VTA the community's answer to an enrolment; the VTA unblinds and keeps the class credentials. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to; its key is derived from this context's base, for events alone (VTI-EVT-212).
